title: Tunnel comparisons and tool against tool pages
items: New comparisons with Cloudflare Tunnel and Pinggy, and a localhost tunnels checklist on the compare page

New pages that compare two other tools: ngrok vs Hookdeck, ngrok vs Webhook.site, Hookdeck vs Webhook.site, ngrok vs LocalTunnel, ngrok vs Cloudflare Tunnel, Webhook.site vs RequestBin and Mailtrap vs Mailosaur
The LocalTunnel comparison covers whk share and live tunnels, and the ngrok and Hookdeck comparisons link to the two-tool pages instead of answering them in their FAQs
The blog post on ngrok alternatives now leads to the ngrok comparison, which is kept up to date
